notes.title: MatchOOlu for Android!
notes.content:
MatchOOlu is now available for Android via the Google Play store! Enjoy the same content available on the PC version, but on your Android powered device!  The launch bundle is available for purchase if you enjoy the game and are looking for even more ways to play, or just want to support development.

More information can be found at:

https://matchoolu.com

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ultivan.matchoolu]Android Store Page[/url]
